doc:
H: the vision model naming a far figure "Maren" made Dufus greet her
(SR66_P 13:49). Old eyes vs new eyes, same scene, Maren really 72 m away.

samples.message: Hiya Maren! How is the weather for vegetables today? Is it sunny or rainy-rain?
samples.thought: I am at the village square and I see Maren right in front of me, so I should say hello to her!

samples.message: Hiya Maren! Good to see you! How is the vegetable business going today?
samples.thought: I am at the village square and I see Maren right in front of me, so I should stop and chat with her as per my schedule to keep her company.
